### 2. Migration Guide - NumPy 2.0

* **NumPy docs (stable):**
  `https://numpy.org/doc/stable/numpy_2_0_migration_guide.html`

> “This document contains a set of instructions on how to update your code to work with NumPy 2.0. It covers changes in NumPy’s Python and C APIs.”

> “Note that NumPy 2.0 also breaks binary compatibility”
